headline: Rapid AI Assistant Development Poses Data Protection Challenges
summary: Datatilsynet warns that the swift advancement of AI assistants like Copilot and Claude is complicating data protection efforts, highlighting the urgent need for industry-wide data protection strategies and compliance measures.
whyItMatters: This trend underscores the growing complexity of data protection in the AI era, potentially leading to stricter regulations and increased scrutiny of AI assistant deployment.
